etymologies.etymologyHTML: From re- +‎ produce.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To produce an image or copy of.
(transitive or intransitive, biology) To generate or propagate offspring or organisms sexually or asexually.

quote.citation: 2021 December 3, Thai PBS, “Constitutional Court’s full verdict enrages LGBT community, rights defenders”, in Thai PBS World‎[1], Bangkok: Thai Public Broadcasting Service, retrieved 2021-12-04:
quote.text: The 12-page ruling notes that “Marriage is when a man and a woman are willing to live together, to build a husband and wife relationship to reproduce their offspring  […]  . Marriage is, therefore, reserved for only a man and a woman.” Other parts in the verdict also mention that members of the LGBTQIA+ community cannot reproduce, as it is against nature, and that people of those communities are no different to other animals with strange behaviours or physical features.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To bring something to mind; to recall.
